assertions.name: family_a_disagrees_jones_at_h2_corrected
assertions.source: With the CORRECT Kauffman-Jones normalisation [2]_q² = q² + 2 + q⁻² (matching `BorromeanMarkovTrace.lean § h2_coefficient_cancellation`), the h² coefficient of tr_M(β_Bor) is exactly ZERO.  Family A's +3/4 h² coefficient is a SEPARATE Wedderburn sum on H_4, not derivable from the H_3 Markov trace via the simple bridge linking_weight = 5/2 + 4·(tr_M − 1). The two are different mathematical objects.

assertions.name: family_a_terminates_at_h2
assertions.source: Family A linking_weight = (1/4)·Σ_{λ⊢4} dim_q V_λ = 5/2 + (3/4) h² terminates exactly at h² (Lean-proved in lambda-scale-substrate-form.lean).

assertions.name: jones_has_h4_or_higher_correction_above_unit_threshold
assertions.source: Jones polynomial V(𝓑₃, q²) is degree-3 in q²; its expansion in h necessarily has terms beyond h².  Max |c_{2k>2}| ≈ 3.03 (the h⁴ coefficient).  Pass iff |c_{h⁴}| > 1.

assertions.name: jones_closer_to_target_than_family_a
assertions.source: Lean-correct Jones gives |residual| = 0.0342964, Family A gives |residual| = 0.0728274.  Jones closes 52.91% of Family A's residual at q₀.  This re-opens the question of which linking_weight is categorically correct.

description: γγ̄ pair-production decomposition of β_Bor = (σ₀σ₁⁻¹)³ at each Gröbner-Shirshov filtration order (h-power).  Compares PROVED Family A linking_weight (which terminates at h²) against the Markov-trace-via-Jones-polynomial route (all orders in h) and against the CODATA-anchor target.  Localises whether the 2.89% VolDensity(𝓑₃) gap enters at h² (Reading-A hypothesis: +3/4 h² should be −G h²) or at h⁴⁺ (q-dilog tower hypothesis: Family A truncates higher-order corrections). Audit-only — no CODATA value flows into a prediction; the anchor inversion is for target reconstruction only.

gap_localisation.interpretation: Family A (Wedderburn dim sum on H_4) and Jones (H_3 Markov trace of β_Bor, Lean-proved closed form via [2]_q² normalisation) DISAGREE at h² coefficient: Family A's +3/4 vs Jones's 0.  Both are independently Lean-proved theorems about DIFFERENT mathematical objects.  Numerically, the Lean-correct Jones value lands ~47% closer to the CODATA-anchor target than Family A — suggesting the actual `linking_weight` may be the H_3 Markov trace, not the H_4 Wedderburn dim sum.  Open question: which is the categorically-correct `linking_weight`?  The simple bridge `linking_weight = 5/2 + 4·(tr_M − 1)` is itself a hack (forces tr_M(q=1)=1 to equal Family A's 5/2 by adding a constant).
